items.title: Uncensored survival-to-death Fishtank successor: large-n (60 segments/seed x 2 seeds) health_depleted death-time characterization on the 906b ecology tier
items.note: Routed from chip-20260810-fishtank-uncensored-survival, spawned from organism_lifespan_development_review_906_lineage_2026-08-10.md Section 2/10 item 1 (right-censoring across the 906 lineage: 906a 0%, 906b 75%, 906c 87.5%, 911 100% -- 0/8 segments died -- mean_realized_segment_steps has stopped measuring survival at all). SUBSTRATE READINESS FINDING (Step 2.5a empirical probe -- see module docstring for full detail): CausalGridWorldV2.step()'s per-episode step cap is a HARDCODED LITERAL (causal_grid_world.py:3067, `_step_cap_reached = self.steps >= 500`), NOT a driver-configurable parameter -- contradicting the implicit premise in both the review's proposed successor text and the chip's own prompt that raising the driver's step-cap argument would remove censoring 'without any code change'. Neither of the chip's two literal design options (raise the per-segment cap; add a terminal-death branch) is buildable from /queue-experiment alone -- both need a substrate change. Per Step 2.5a, did NOT write a script assuming the false premise; instead designed a driver-only-achievable variant: instead of lengthening segments (impossible without the substrate change), this run scales the NUMBER of segments/seed from 8 to 60 (~7.5x), converting the prior single-run n=8 mostly-censored point estimate into a proper survival-analysis characterization (uncensored health_depleted death-time list + pct_right_censored, pooled across seeds). Pre-registered PASS threshold: >=10 genuine (uncensored) death events across both seeds combined (MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL); even on FAIL, pct_right_censored_pooled and n_uncensored_deaths_total are the load-bearing scientific readouts of this characterization run. ECOLOGY CHOICE: deliberately reuses 906b's EVAL_ENV_EXTRA_KWARGS unmodified (NOT 911's resource-field retune) -- 911's own scored run produced ZERO deaths in 8 segments, which would make a 60-segment characterization on that ecology tier likely still fully censored, defeating this run's purpose; 906b (2/8 deaths) and 906c (1/8, replicate) are the two configs that still reliably produce genuine health_depleted terminations. Adds lifetime_affective_occupancy reporting per reef_ecology_strategy_affective_occupancy_review_2026-08-10.md Section 9 (this run's 60 segments/seed is ~7.5x the prior lineage's 8, the review's own trigger condition for adding this SENT-2 hygiene statistic; non-gating, descriptive only, no welfare/sentience inference). Closes the organism-lifespan review's Section-1-flagged cumulative-step-counter gap (cumulative_step_start/cumulative_step_end stamped per segment). Episode-log companion is deliberately THINNED (full per-step records kept only for the first 3 segments/seed + every genuinely-died segment; other censored segments stored as a per-segment summary) to bound the committed artifact size (906b/911's own 8-segment logs are already 9.5-10.5MB; unthinned at 120 segments this would be ~140MB) -- all reported statistics are computed from the full, unthinned in-memory data before thinning is applied. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (a large-n within-cap death-time distribution at this ecology tier) recorded in NO existing manifest -- every 906-lineage run caps at 8 segments and reports at most a single mean, never a distribution; not recoverable by reanalysis. Re-derive brake (2.5b): claim_ids=[], not applicable. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entry touches causal_grid_world.py or this driver's other imports. claim_ids=[] (diagnostic showcase, does not weight governance), EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic. Smoke PASS: --dry-run (3 segments x 30 steps/seed) exercised the full curriculum + eval + survival-stats + occupancy-stats + thinning code paths cleanly; z_goal_stream smoke check reports 'no writer defect' (active_frac=0.998); verdict/progress-instrumentation lines present and correctly denominated. FOLLOW-ON (chipped separately, not built here): parameterize CausalGridWorldV2's per-episode step cap (a `max_episode_steps` constructor kwarg, default 500, replacing the causal_grid_world.py:3067 literal, fully backward-compatible) via /implement-substrate -- needed for a TRUE per-segment-uncensored design (either of the chip's original two literal options) rather than this run's segment-count-scaling variant. items.title: MECH-489 (SD-099) defensive-orienting decision retest after SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE fix
items.note: Re-queue of V3-EXQ-910 (script copied, not edited in place -- v3_exq_910_mech489_defensive_orienting_validation.py is preserved unchanged as the exact historical record of that run) after implementing SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE via /implement-substrate this session (docs/architecture/sd_orienting_decision_scale.md, ree_core/agent.py select_action() Component 4/5). failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-910_2026-08-10.md found MECH-489's Component 4/5 (approach/withdraw/resume decision) confounded by a norm-vs-value scale mismatch (structurally non-negative z_harm_s L2 norm compared directly against a near-zero-unless-close benefit RBF value), which biased every override toward withdraw regardless of actual event valence (206/206 logged overrides in V3-EXQ-910). Fix: both channels now z-scored against their own running mean/mean-absolute-deviation (EMA, frozen while orienting is active) before comparison. New readiness precondition pooled_overrides_count_sufficient (>=5 pooled Component-4/5 overrides across ON-arm seeds) gates criterion (c)'s meaningfulness, mirroring the existing per-event-field readiness preconditions. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (decision_alignment as a function of the FIXED comparison logic) does not exist in any prior manifest -- the fix did not exist before this session; not recoverable by reanalysis, a run is required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): MECH-489 autopsy count against substrate_ceiling = 0 (the one prior autopsy read a code-bug confound, not a ceiling) -- brake does not fire. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entry other than this one (now implemented_pending_validation) touches ree_core/agent.py or this driver's other imports.
